existing_sdc.basis: constraints/timing.sdc:1,10 明确针对 picorv32_pcpi_div 并对顶层端口 clk 建钟；:20-27 使用 all_inputs/all_outputs 泛化约束，与顶层端口集一致，无引用外部缺失文件

ports.name: clk
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:63 声明；:80,:106 作为 always @(posedge clk) 时钟

ports.name: resetn
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:63 声明；:86,:95-96,:111 作为低有效复位条件使用

ports.name: pcpi_valid
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:65 声明；:86 参与指令捕获条件

ports.name: pcpi_insn
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:66 声明 [31:0]；:86-92 用于译码

ports.name: pcpi_rs1
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:67 声明 [31:0]；:116-118 作为被除数来源

ports.name: pcpi_rs2
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:68 声明 [31:0]；:117-118 作为除数来源

ports.name: pcpi_wr
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:69 声明 output reg；:108,:125 寄存器输出

ports.name: pcpi_rd
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:70 声明 output reg [31:0]；:109,:135-137 寄存器输出

ports.name: pcpi_wait
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:71 声明 output reg；:95 寄存器输出

ports.name: pcpi_ready
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:72 声明 output reg；:107,:124 寄存器输出

clocks.name: core_clk
clocks.basis: rtl/design.v:80,:106 所有时序逻辑均为 posedge clk，无内部分频/门控；constraints/timing.sdc:10 create_clock -name core_clk [get_ports clk]，:10 waveform {0 10} 对应上升沿采样

resets.basis: rtl/design.v:86（if (resetn && ...)）、:95-96（&& resetn）、:111（if (!resetn)）均在 always @(posedge clk) 内作为同步条件，敏感列表无 resetn，故为低有效同步复位

io_clock_associations.basis: rtl/design.v:86 在 posedge clk 块内采样；constraints/timing.sdc:20-21 归入 data_inputs 并以 core_clk 约束
rtl/design.v:86-92 在 posedge clk 块内采样；constraints/timing.sdc:20-21
rtl/design.v:116,:118 在 posedge clk 块内采样；constraints/timing.sdc:20-21
rtl/design.v:117-118 在 posedge clk 块内采样；constraints/timing.sdc:20-21
rtl/design.v:108,:125 由 posedge clk 驱动输出；constraints/timing.sdc:25-26 以 core_clk 约束 all_outputs
rtl/design.v:109,:135-137 由 posedge clk 驱动输出；constraints/timing.sdc:25-26
rtl/design.v:95 由 posedge clk 驱动输出；constraints/timing.sdc:25-26
